plain: Deep loyalty and dedication to a cause or person.

webster.text: The state of being dedicated, consecrated, or solemnly set apart for a particular purpose.

more.text: A solemn attention to the Supreme Being in worship; a yielding of the heart and affections to God, with reverence, faith and piety, in religious duties, particularly in prayer and meditation; devoutness.
External worship; acts of religion; performance of religious duties.
An act of reverence, respect or ceremony.
Ardent love or affection; attachment manifested by constant attention; as, the duke was distinguished by his devotion to the king, and to the interest of the nation.
Disposal; power of disposing of; state of dependence.

example.quote: And they have excluded from eligibility to this trust, all those who from situation might be suspected of too great devotion to the President in office.
